Karvan İdman Klubu is an Azerbaijani professional football club based in Yevlakh that participates in the Azerbaijan Premier League after promotion from the Azerbaijan First Division in 2025. It was the first Azerbaijani club to pass the first qualification stage in the UEFA Cup.
